# Tree-hygiene allowlist (see .github/workflows/tree-hygiene.yml).

# One path-prefix per line. A line matches the entry itself or anything beneath
# it (e.g. `dir/` matches `dir/foo.txt`). Blank lines and lines starting with
# `#` are ignored. Keep this list minimal: every entry must be genuinely
# required to reference internal hostnames / the private infra repo by name.

# Dispatches `repository_dispatch` (and mints an app token scoped to) the
# private infra repo by name — required for the preview-environment contract.
.github/workflows/preview.yml

# Session-mode Playwright lanes must name the deployed dev stack: the
# self-hosted `memory` runners are not the gateway host, so no localhost default
# can work there. These are public DNS names (not private infrastructure) and
# scrubbing them would make the scheduled lanes unrunnable (#1901).
.github/workflows/web-ui-mutations.yml
.github/workflows/web-ui-llm-scenarios.yml
